rows.note: Use 法律 as the all-purpose noun for the legal system, an individual law in general, or law as an academic subject.

example.english: Hong Kong law doesn't allow smoking in parks.
example.traditional: 香港嘅法律唔容許喺公園吸煙。
example.jyutping: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 faat3 leot6 m4 jung4 heoi2 hai2 gung1 jyun4 kap1 jin1

rows.note: Use 規矩 for a rule of behaviour or social conduct rather than an enacted statute.

example.english: When you're a guest at someone else's home, you have to follow the law of good manners.
example.traditional: 去人哋屋企做客，要守規矩。
example.jyutping: heoi3 jan4 dei6 uk1 kei2 zou6 haak3 jiu3 sau2 gwai1 geoi2

rows.note: Use 治安 for the public order and security maintained by obeying the law.

example.english: There isn't much law and order in this area at night, so don't walk alone.
example.traditional: 呢區夜晚治安麻麻，唔好一個人行。
example.jyutping: ni1 keoi1 je6 maan5 zi6 on1 maa4 maa4 m4 hou2 jat1 go3 jan4 haang4

rows.note: Use 定律 for an established scientific law describing an invariant relationship between phenomena.

example.english: The law of gravity explains why objects fall to the ground.
example.traditional: 萬有引力定律解釋點解物件會跌落地。
example.jyutping: maan6 jau5 jan5 lik6 ding6 leot6 gaai2 sik1 dim2 gaai2 mat6 gin6 wui5 dit3 lok6 dei6
